headline: Sensex Ends Flat While Financials Lead Gains and Oil India Profits Double

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices provided underlying support to Indian equities.
Financial and auto stocks led gains across benchmark indices during trading.
Strong premium growth in the life insurance sector supported investor sentiment in financial stocks.
Solid quarterly corporate performance from select energy companies boosted individual stock prices.
whatHappening: Sensex ended largely flat with NIFTY50 holding around the 25,229–25,300 level.
Oil India's net profit more than doubled driven by better realisations and higher output.
Vodafone Idea reported a widened Q2 loss of ₹5,975 crore despite higher revenue and ARPU.
HDFC Life and Bajaj Finance emerged as top gainers among benchmark constituents.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices closed largely flat with Nifty holding above 25,250, supported by financials and foreign fund inflows.
Oil India posted strong earnings as its net profit more than doubled, while Vodafone Idea reported a widening Q2 net loss of ₹5,975 crore.
HDFC Life and Bajaj Finance were key top gainers, while smallcaps continued to outperform for a second straight session.
